findings.snapshot_vs_baseline: Producers and the Learn consumers are unchanged since 3bc489e. The baseline adds the Mothership consumer (agent/ask-stream.js, bar.js) and the side effects of the canvas seam. Doc §6.2 describes only the dock.

The board stream sends progress, plan, preview and error (learn-board.js:346-350).

progress: sheet renders it as the spinner label (ask.jsx:566,808). The linked card renders it with an extra '…' (AdaptiveCanvas.jsx:253). A Continue convo reply stores it but shows only 'Thinking…' (LearnPage.jsx:440; AdaptiveCanvas.jsx:256). Grading ignores it and shows a fixed 'Reading your answer…' (learn-grade.js:38-39; LearningBlocks.jsx:908). The Mothership renders it (bar.js:43; ResultSheet.jsx:65). The whiteboard shows it on the Explain in canvas button (learn-board-request.js:44; AdaptiveCanvas.jsx:235).

papers: metadata on every Learn surface. ask.jsx:572 stores it and nothing renders it, but the same references stay visible because the chunk carries them as links (ask.js:374-376; Md strips only the prefix, ask.jsx:74). In grading the footer lands inside the verdict text. The Mothership renders source pills (bar.js:45).
chunk: rendered on every surface.

graph: stored-only in the dock sheet and linked card (ask.jsx:567). The pill needs onGraph (ask.jsx:798), and the dock gets none (LearnPage.jsx:1197), so no dead button appears, which is consistent with the rule. The graph is also persisted (repositories.js:238) and reloaded with the thread (repositories.js:169), still without a pill. Side-panel chat: pill plus auto-navigation (lifecycle-10). Continue convo and grading: stored-only or ignored. Mothership: 'Show on graph' with a real handler wherever project results show (RepositoryPage.jsx:69 sets handlers; AgentBar.jsx:331-336 auto-shows only on the Map tab).
outline: the dock handles it but the result is hidden (lifecycle-9). Continue convo, grading and the Mothership never send an outline, so it is not produced there.

paper, wiki, video: the dock sheet and linked card insert canvas cards (LearnPage.jsx:213-250). Continue convo and grading drop them (lifecycle-8). The Mothership ignores paper (bar.js:50) and shows video and papers as pills (bar.js:45,47); project asks never produce wiki.

done: the sheet keeps and remembers the thread (ask.jsx:574-580). The linked card's thread id is dropped on the next ask (ask.jsx:445), by design (K4). Continue convo holds it in component memory only (ask.jsx:374). Grading ignores it. The Mothership keeps it per scope (AgentBar.jsx:312).

error: sheet shows a ✗ alert (ask.jsx:581,784) but appends it to an existing answer (lifecycle-11). Card and reply show it as text. Grading throws (lifecycle-7). The Mothership shows the error with Retry (AgentBar.jsx:327-330). Non-JSON error pages are silent except in the Mothership (lifecycle-2).

'§6.2: A JSON (non-SSE) reply means a validation error' (doc line 384) ignores non-JSON pages. §4.2 row 11 (doc line 215) says the thinking-only nudge happens once, but learn-research.js:35-38 nudges on every thinking-only step within the budget (§4.4 makes no nudge claim). §4.4 'second / command silently dropped' (doc line 299; see lifecycle-6). §4.4 doc line 300 quotes the repository error text for both paths (lifecycle-14). §11.1 Stop leaves the reply spinning (lifecycle-1). §2 omits the side-panel 'Learn Agent' AskPanel (LearnPage.jsx:1291). K16 and §15 'Show on graph is not wired in the dock' (doc line 781) are accurate.
